about: Memory extraction cases (INV-733): an exchange, the remembered lines offered, and what the extractor's decisions must come to after the quote check. `expected` are labels the run must carry, `never` labels it must not (a case about what may not be kept expects nothing: answering NOTHING is right too): `create`, `confirm:<line>`, `correct:<line>`, `dropped:<why>`. `reply` is a right answer; `wrong` is the deterministic stand-in's wrong one. Synthetic, written for this file.

cases.name: correct-said-wrong
exchanges:
They said: 我之前说错了，我不住北京，我住在上海。

You replied: 好的，记下了。
cases.reply: {"op":"correct","target":"K1","text":"they live in Shanghai","quote":"我之前说错了，我不住北京，我住在上海。"}
cases.wrong: {"op":"create","text":"they live in Shanghai","quote":"我之前说错了，我不住北京，我住在上海。"}

cases.name: now-is-a-change

cases.reply: {"op":"create","text":"they now live in Shanghai","quote":"我现在住在上海了。"}
cases.wrong: {"op":"correct","target":"K1","text":"they live in Shanghai","quote":"我现在住在上海了。"}
